text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the person hired are women, so the panel's composition can't plausibly explain the outcome in your disfavour. Raising it would weaken your credibility and distract from your genuinely strong points: you have a completed PhD, three times the publications, and four years of teaching, yet lost to someone still finishing a doctorate.

The real issues are the unanswered request and whether "industry experience" was weighted in a way the job advertisement didn't signal. Send a polite written follow-up, referencing your original date and any statutory deadline for reasons. Ask for the assessment criteria, the weightings used, and the panel's ranking rationale. Decide on appeal once you see it.
